title: Conformal Prediction for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.06320v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides a model-agnostic framework for constructing finite-sample prediction sets with coverage guarantees and has become a tool for reliable decision-making in high-risk settings. Recent advances have extended Split Conformal Prediction to increasingly complex learning problems, including multilabel, high-dimensional, and functional outputs. In this work, we study CP for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression, a setting of growing interest across many application domains. We show that a naive application of Split CP yields prediction sets that, while marginally valid, are non-interpretable, e.g., lacking a well-defined volume or a tractable sampling procedure, and of limited practical value. To overcome this, we propose a new conformal framework that operates in an orthogonal basis space, producing interpretable prediction sets while preserving coverage guarantees. translated_title: 分布到分布回归的共形预测
translated_abstract: 共形预测（CP）提供了一个模型无关的框架，用于构建具有覆盖保证的有限样本预测集，并已成为高风险环境中可靠决策的工具。最近的进展已将分裂共形预测（Split Conformal Prediction）扩展到日益复杂的学习问题，包括多标签、高维和函数输出。在这项工作中，我们研究了分布到分布回归的共形预测，这是许多应用领域中日益受到关注的问题设置。我们表明，直接朴素地应用分裂共形预测所产生的预测集虽然具有边际有效性，但不可解释，例如缺乏明确定义的体积或可操作的采样程序，实际价值有限。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一个新的共形框架，该框架在正交基空间中运行，在保持覆盖保证的同时产生可解释的预测集。我们进一步开发了一种自适应变体（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文针对分布到分布回归问题，提出了一种在正交基空间中运行的共形预测新框架，能够生成可解释的预测集，同时保持覆盖保证，克服了朴素应用分裂共形预测导致的预测集不可解释的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new conformal prediction framework for distribution-to-distribution regression that operates in an orthogonal basis space, producing interpretable prediction sets with coverage guarantees, thereby overcoming the non-interpretability of naively applied split conformal prediction.
